word: A young boy named Lucas breaks his bicycle.
answer: Un niño joven llamado Lucas rompe su bicicleta.

word: He fears telling his father the truth.
answer: Él teme decirle la verdad a su padre.

word: Lucas hides behind the garden shed nervously.
answer: Lucas se esconde detrás del cobertizo nerviosamente.

word: His mother surprises him with unexpected kindness.
answer: Su madre lo sorprende con amabilidad inesperada.

word: Does he owe an apology to his father?
answer: ¿Él debe una disculpa a su padre?

word: Yes, he should tell what really happened.
answer: Sí, él debe contar lo que realmente pasó.

word: His mother promises to help him explain.
answer: Su madre promete ayudarlo a explicar.

word: She puts a warm hand on his shoulder.
answer: Ella mete una mano cálida en su hombro.

word: Success depends on telling the truth soon.
answer: El éxito depende de contar la verdad pronto.

word: What happens when his father learns about it?
answer: ¿Qué sucede cuando su padre se entera?

word: His father actually protects him from blame.
answer: Su padre realmente lo protege de culpa.

word: They fear the bicycle repair cost together.
answer: Temen el costo de reparación juntos.

word: I break promises when I am dishonest.
answer: Rompo promesas cuando soy deshonesto.

word: You should tell your parents about problems.
answer: Tú debes contar a tus padres sobre problemas.

word: She hides nothing from her loved ones.
answer: Ella no esconde nada de sus seres queridos.

word: We are surprised by his father's reaction.
answer: Nos sorprende la reacción del padre.

word: They promise to fix the bicycle together.
answer: Prometen reparar la bicicleta juntos.

word: He puts the broken pieces in a box.
answer: Él mete los pedazos rotos en una caja.

word: I fear making similar mistakes again.
answer: Temo cometer errores similares de nuevo.

word: Does her honesty protect their relationship truly?
answer: ¿Su honestidad protege su relación verdaderamente?

word: Yes, trust depends on telling the truth.
answer: Sí, la confianza depende de contar la verdad.

word: What surprising thing happens at the repair shop?
answer: ¿Qué cosa sorprendente sucede en el taller?

word: The mechanic breaks the repair cost in half.
answer: El mecánico rompe el costo a la mitad.

word: Lucas learns he should not fear mistakes.
answer: Lucas aprende que no debe temer errores.

word: His father hides his own childhood failures.
answer: Su padre esconde sus propios fracasos infantiles.

word: He promises Lucas a better bicycle soon.
answer: Promete a Lucas una bicicleta mejor pronto.

word: They put their fears aside together.
answer: Ponen sus miedos a un lado juntos.

word: The family protects each other with honesty.
answer: La familia se protege mutuamente con honestidad.

word: Lucas depends on his parents for support.
answer: Lucas depende de sus padres para apoyo.

word: Everything that happens teaches him about love.
answer: Todo lo que sucede le enseña sobre amor.
